FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 2
Committee: Confirmations Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 07/17/2023
Senate Bill 2 as introduced provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of Alabama's U.S.
Congressional districts. This bill will not affect state funding.
